# Public page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A sessionless public page (landing, help, privacy, terms, a guest's error) in the kit's PublicShell: route Public/ pages to it from the layout callback, set each page's head with PublicMeta, and serve legal and help text through the Public/Markdown page, sanitized on the server. There is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.public-legal`.

Kit: shell PublicShell (pages/Workspace/Partials/PublicShell.vue), shell PublicMeta (pages/Workspace/Partials/PublicMeta.vue), shell Public/Markdown/Page with PublicMarkdown::page(), @kit/ui Toaster.
Checks: js-imports, ui new-tab. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- The layout callback routes public pages to the kit's PublicShell, imported from @/pages/Workspace/Partials/PublicShell.vue (a guest's Workspace/Error/Page too); never a hand-rolled public header and footer.
- Each public page sets its head with PublicMeta (title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card): no tracking tags.
- Legal and help text is markdown rendered on the server by PublicMarkdown::page() (raw HTML stripped, unsafe links refused) into Public/Markdown/Page; the page shows only that sanitized HTML.
- The footer's links come from one source: the shared shell footer (the brand config), or the shell's footer-links and footer-note props on a host without session-ui; never a second config for the same links.
- A branded site uses the shell's opt-in props (width=site, align-bars, tone=bar, pin-footer, padded, theme) and its slots (mark, nav, cta, footer-mark), not a fork of the shell.
- Tests: the skip link to #content, the CTA states, the footer links, and phone width (390px) and labelled landmarks. The kit's own coverage of these is by source; there is no browser or axe run, so accessibility is checked at source level, not rendered.

Related: `ui-page.public.byo`.

Graduates: Graduate to ready when a generator scaffolds a public page and its route.
